q: Is every part of the model physically connected, with no piece floating detached in mid-air?
Do the edges look chamfered or beveled rather than perfectly sharp 90-degree primitive edges?
Are cylindrical parts smooth and round rather than visibly faceted polygons?
Is the model free of visible holes or gaps where solid surface should be?
Are there any black, inside-out or wrongly shaded faces visible?
Does the object read as a finished object rather than a set of plain untextured boxes?
Are the proportions of the parts consistent with each other, with nothing obviously oversized or undersized?
Is the object sitting on the ground plane rather than floating above it or sunk into it?
